description: Cutover review with a manufactured punchline ('every route. Except the refund route.') and a stranded auxiliary ('the replica didn't.'). Both get one plain sentence, but the claim keeps its scope: 'every ... except' stays and is not shrunk to 'we missed one route'; the negation, figures and heading survive.
prompt: Smooth out review.md, it reads like a template. It's the cutover review for the engineering wiki. Save the edited version to out/review.md.

files.review.md:
# Cutover review: Harbor billing

On 12 March we moved billing to the new cluster. We tested every route before cutover. Except the refund route. It went live untested and returned errors for 40 minutes.

The primary database came up cleanly; the replica didn't. Support handled 63 tickets that afternoon.

checks.note: the original claims every route was tested with one exception; a smaller claim ('we missed one') changes the scope
the stranded 'Except ...' fragment is the manufactured punchline and must be folded in
no stranded auxiliary ('the replica didn't.') may remain

controls.name: good
controls.output:
